limitations: Private proposed writer accounting; qualified protocol review required before release.
Fee entitlements belong to the wallet LP balance. Gauge custody and gauge rewards have separate ownership.
Arithmetic follows checked uint256 products and floor division. Stored claims survive LP withdrawal; fee dust may remain in PoolFees.

accounting.zeroBalance: Return storedClaimable directly; _updateFor resets the user index without subtraction.
accounting.claim: claimFees materializes both indices, zeroes both claimables and pays the caller from PoolFees; emits Claim only if either amount is positive.
accounting.transfer: _updateFor updates sender and recipient before LP balances change.
